sources: https://dnr.illinois.gov/parks/camp/park.lowden.html (read 2026-11-13): 'There are 80 Class A campsites, which include electricity, a shower building, and a sanitary dumping station for trailers. note: Illinois DNR park at Oregon, on a wooded bluff above the Rock River (Black Hawk statue). Three loops (Shady Rest, Sun Valley, White Oak) sit in the uplands, about 350 m from the river. A summer refreshment stand sells drinks, ice and firewood. --Claude
